steps.text: Hi, you've reached {{bank_name}}. I'm the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded.
Hi Daniel, how can I help you today?
G'day. I've been charged a fifteen dollar overdrawn fee and I don't reckon that's fair. My insurance came out the day before my pay went in.

steps.summary: Daniel is unhappy about a $15 overdrawn fee caused by a direct debit the day before payday.

steps.text: That's frustrating, let's take a look. I've sent a notification to your banking app. Can you tap Approve for me?
Thanks Daniel. One moment, I'm just checking your fees.
I can see it: a fifteen dollar overdrawn fee from two days ago, and it's the first fee you've had with us. What happened there?
I moved some money into savings and forgot the insurance direct debit was due. It tipped me over by a few dollars, and my pay landed the next morning.
Thanks, that makes sense. One moment while I put a refund request through for you.

args.summary: Daniel was charged a $15 overdrawn fee after an insurance direct debit came out the day before his salary arrived. It is his first fee and he is asking for it to be refunded.
args.customer_statement: I moved some money into savings and forgot the insurance direct debit was due. It tipped me over by a few dollars, and my pay landed the next morning.

steps.text: That's lodged, and your case number is {{propose_action.case_number}}. {{propose_action.handled_by.name}} from our team is reviewing it, and you'll hear back {{propose_action.expected_timing}}.
I can't promise the outcome, but I've noted it's your first fee in more than nine years with us. We'll text you as soon as it's decided.

steps.summary: Refund request for the $15 overdrawn fee lodged for staff review. Daniel knows the case number and timing.

steps.text: No worries, Daniel. Have a good one.
